facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but you must bring all foreign service earnings back to Tunisia.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: a PPR account holds service fees in foreign currency or convertible dinars.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Konnect lets freelancers take international card payments, paid to a Tunisian bank.
facts.L1_registration: Auto-entrepreneur up to TND 75,000 a year, registered online, for listed activities.
facts.L2_tax_id: Matricule fiscal, from your local tax office with your CIN.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Auto-entrepreneurs pay one small yearly contribution covering income tax, VAT and social security.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 19% VAT, but services used by clients abroad are outside Tunisian VAT.
facts.L5_data_protection: Declare any personal data processing to the INPDP first.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can withdraw within 10 working days.
facts.L7_incentives: Auto-entrepreneur single contribution, nothing due in year one, and the PPR currency account.

watch_out.text: Foreign wallet balances aren't a lawful place to keep your earnings.
Processing personal data without declaring it to INPDP can mean prison.
Check your activity is on the auto-entrepreneur list before registering.
